thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy v4.0.0 in prod-eu-west-1 showing error spike. Canary-02 returning 503/500 for ~30% of requests since 1736054300. Suspected culprit: in-progress migration '2026_04_state_enum_expand'. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migrations
sam.oncall: Im taking lead. Paging DB and SRE oncall. Tagging runbook and incident template.
nina-sre: Affected routes observed: /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. Error pattern looks like enum parse failures in logs: "ERROR: invalid input value for enum \"model_status\"".
maria-dev: Reproduced locally against canary-02. Trace shows service hitting new enum value "beta_experiment" while code still expects older set.
omar-db: DB oncall here. Looking at migration worker logs: migration started on canary-02 at 1736054298, got a lock while ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE ran. Another backend held a ShareLock; deadlock was reported.
deploy-bot: Migration task 10012: status=FAILED on canary-02. Log excerpt: ```ERROR: deadlock detected
DETAIL: Process 9821 waits for ShareLock on transaction 11345; blocked by process 9800.
HINT: See server log for query details.
```
kate-support: Impact: 9 customers had failed calls past 10m window; highest-request tenant "metro-shop" saw bulk ingestion errors. Ops tickets incoming.
sam.oncall: Priority P1. Immediate plan: 1) try to terminate the blocking backend to release migration 2) flip kill-switch feature flag to force old schema 3) roll back canary image to v3.9.8 if traffic doesn't stabilize 4) notify customers.
omar-db: I'll inspect pg_stat_activity. Command Ill run: ```SELECT pid, usename, query_start, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%ALTER TYPE%' OR query ILIKE '%ALTER TABLE%'``` then `pg_terminate_backend(pid)` for blockers.
yuri-eng: I'll prepare flag toggle. Flag: toggle:model-status-v4. I can set it to "off" via flag-service (propagates in ~40s).
maria-dev: Flag flip should cause service to avoid new enum variant paths. Can we confirm consumer libs read flag live?
nina-sre: They do, but note some long-lived processes may cache behavior. We'll still proceed with db kill if needed.
yuri-eng: Toggling feature flag OFF now. :gear: -> done. Propagation shows 3/3 regions acknowledged in eu-west.
maria-dev: After flag OFF, 503s dropped on canary-01, but canary-02 still 500s. Logs show backend queries still failing during session start.
omar-db: Found blocker PID 9800 running for 12m, owning a transaction from 'migrator' service. I'll terminate PID 9800. Proceeding.
omar-db: :warning: Terminated PID 9800. Re-checking migrations.
deploy-bot: Migration task 10012 now in ABORTED state on canary-02. No automated compensating migration run.
yuri-eng: Given aborted migration and inconsistent schema, recommending canary rollback to v3.9.8 to reduce risk. Nina, can SRE trigger?
nina-sre: Ill start rollback. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/canary -n prod-eu-west-1 --to-revision=v3.9.8`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated -> canary replicas updating.
yuri-eng: Note: partial enum values may still exist in DB rows (some rows already set to 'beta_experiment'). We need a reconciliation: either backfill to allowed old values or complete migration uniformly.
om ar-db: Proposing path: snapshot DB, run a reversible backfill converting unknown enum values to 'unknown' string in models table using a safe cast path, then run a controlled ALTER TYPE in maintenance window. I will publish exact commands to runbook channel.
kate-support: Sent customer interim status: "We observed elevated errors for some API calls in EU region. We have flipped a safety flag and rolled back canary; mitigation in progress. ETA 1-3 hours for full resolution"
product-led: Good. Also notify account reps for affected tenants.
nina-sre: Rollback complete on canary nodes :white_check_mark:. Observability shows error rate returned to baseline for most routes.
omar-db: After rollback, DB has inconsistent enum entries on about 372 rows. Running dry-run update: ```UPDATE models SET status = 'unknown' WHERE status = 'beta_experiment' LIMIT 1000; -- dry-run mode to validate```
omar-db: Dry-run indicated 372 affected rows. Performing batched updates (200/txn) now. Monitoring replication and CPU.
omar-db: :white_check_mark: Batched updates completed, replication lag stable. Verified reads from read replicas succeed.
yuri-eng: Services back to normal on canaries. Recommend marking mitigated but keep incident open for RCA and runbook updates.
sam.oncall: Marking mitigated. Incident summary to be updated by incident-bot. Action items: - add a pre-deploy check for ongoing ALTER TYPE in cluster - add deploy gating for enum-type migrations - add automated detection of long-running migration txs and alerting - consider auto-rollback guard for failed migrations.
maria-dev: I'll add unit/integration tests for enum transitions and update migration harness to fail fast when cluster-wide locks present.
kate-support: Updated status page and sent customer follow-up note that immediate impact resolved; final RCA will be shared.
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated at 1736054548. Summary: Partial enum expansion migration aborted mid-rollout, causing deadlock and schema divergence on canary-02 which led to 500/503 errors for some EU tenants. Mitigations: terminated blocking backend, toggled toggle:model-status-v4 OFF, rolled back canary to v3.9.8, executed safe backfill to normalize enum values. Follow-up: postmortem due in 48h; add pre-deploy migration checks; consider automated rollback on migration failure.
sam.oncall: Thanks team. Dan/Omar (DB) and Nina lead the postmortem. Yuri to update deploy/runbook. Maria to add tests. Kate to finalize customer comms. Closing active ops here; continue artifacts in #postmortems with incident id 1736054321.
yuri-eng: :thumbsup:
maria-dev: will run migration harness across canaries in staging to validate future runs.
kate-support: drafting RCA for public status.
incident-bot: Thread archived.
